title: Complete a cause-and-result sentence
instructions: Choose the option that completes the sentence with correct verb agreement and a correct link between the cause and the result.

parts.prompt: The row of young plants ______ the gardening team moves a screen beside them.

options.text: needs shade in the afternoon, so
need shade in the afternoon, and so

choice_rationales.A: The singular subject row takes needs, and comma plus so correctly joins the cause to its result.
choice_rationales.B: The semicolon gives a correct boundary, but the singular subject row does not agree with need.
choice_rationales.C: Needs agrees with row, but a comma alone still joins two complete clauses.
choice_rationales.D: The link is correct, but the singular subject row does not agree with need.

parts.hint: Find the main noun of the subject in the first clause, then decide how to join the cause to its result.
parts.correct_explanation: The main noun row is singular, so it takes needs, and comma plus so joins the two clauses while showing the result.
